name: Drip Mine
description: An MEV faucet. BCH sent to the shared Drip Mine address is released to miners a little at a time: once per block, anyone can spend a Drip Mine coin back to the address minus a small payout, and that payout is the transaction fee. Nothing ever comes back to the funder or the dripper.

funder.name: Funder
funder.description: Sends BCH to the Drip Mine, a gift to future miners. It cannot be taken back.

dripper.name: Dripper
dripper.description: Anyone who posts a drip. The payout goes to the miner as the fee; the dripper keeps nothing unless they mine the block.

fund.name: Fund the Drip Mine
fund.description: Send $(<fundSatoshis>) satoshis to the Drip Mine. Nobody can get them back: they are released to miners as transaction fees, at most once per block per coin.

funder.name: Fund the Drip Mine
funder.description: Choose how many satoshis to give. A coin of 740 sats or less is paid out whole at its next spend; larger coins drip slowly.

drip.name: Drip
drip.description: Release the largest payout the contract allows from a Drip Mine coin of $(<dripCoinSatoshis>) satoshis. The payout is the transaction fee and goes to the miner; the rest returns to the Drip Mine.

dripper.name: Drip
dripper.description: Pick one Drip Mine coin of more than 740 sats, at least one block old, and enter its value.

terminate.name: Terminate a spent-down coin
terminate.description: Pay out a Drip Mine coin of $(<dripCoinSatoshis>) satoshis (740 or less) whole, as the transaction fee, ending it with a 0-sat OP_RETURN.

dripper.name: Terminate
dripper.description: Pick one Drip Mine coin of 740 sats or less, at least one block old, and enter its value.

fundTransaction.name: Drip Mine funded
fundTransaction.description: $(<fundSatoshis>) satoshis were given to the Drip Mine.

dripTransaction.name: Drip
dripTransaction.description: A Drip Mine coin of $(<dripCoinSatoshis>) satoshis paid $(dripPayout) satoshis to the miner.

terminateTransaction.name: Drip Mine coin terminated
terminateTransaction.description: A Drip Mine coin of $(<dripCoinSatoshis>) satoshis was paid out whole to the miner.

dripMineInput.name: Drip Mine coin
dripMineInput.description: A coin at the Drip Mine address, at least one block old.

fundingOutput.name: Drip Mine coin
fundingOutput.description: $(<fundSatoshis>) satoshis at the Drip Mine address, released to miners over time.

dripRemainderOutput.name: Drip Mine coin (after the drip)
dripRemainderOutput.description: What is left of the coin after the drip, back at the Drip Mine address.

terminalOutput.name: Terminal OP_RETURN
terminalOutput.description: A bare OP_RETURN with 0 satoshis: the whole coin went to the miner as the fee.

dripMineLockingScript.name: Drip Mine
dripMineLockingScript.description: The shared Drip Mine address. Anything sent here can only ever be released to miners.

terminalLockingScript.name: OP_RETURN
terminalLockingScript.description: A bare OP_RETURN, exactly the byte 0x6a, as the contract requires when it terminates a coin.

dustLimit.name: Dust limit
dustLimit.description: The smallest Drip Mine coin a drip may leave behind: the P2SH32 dust limit, 576 satoshis.

minPayout.name: Minimum payout
minPayout.description: The flat payout when the proportional one is smaller: 164 satoshis, the drip transaction size at 1 sat/byte.

decayNumerator.name: Decay numerator
decayNumerator.description: With the denominator, the share of a coin each drip may release: 4392 / 1333036486, a half-life of about four years.

decayDenominator.name: Decay denominator
decayDenominator.description: With the numerator, the share of a coin each drip may release.

fundSatoshis.name: Satoshis to give
fundSatoshis.description: How many satoshis to send to the Drip Mine (at least 576). They go to miners, never back to you.

dripCoinSatoshis.name: Coin value
dripCoinSatoshis.description: The value in satoshis of the Drip Mine coin being spent. The contract rejects the spend if it does not match.
